about.title: My Journey
about.subtitle: A little about me
about.paragraph1: I study Computer Systems Engineering at Tecnológico Nacional de México, Celaya Campus. My main language is Python, which I use to build APIs, system logic and analysis tools. I also work with JavaScript and web technologies, mobile development with Flutter, and electronics prototypes with Arduino and ESP32.
about.paragraph2: In projects such as ATLAS, RECOLECTA and VivaOrden I have worked on territorial analysis, data privacy and business operations. In hackathons and academic projects I have also taken part in solution design, team coordination, 3D modeling and electronics prototypes. I am interested in applied research and in building systems whose scope, sources and limitations can be explained clearly.
